author: Molly Buckley
description: After public outrage, California lawmakers are moving closer to exempting open-source operating systems from the sweeping age-bracketing regime mandated by last year’s Digital Age Assurance Act (AB 1043). Nonetheless, the current bill still jeopardizes internet users’ speech, privacy, and security. While the open source exemption, if passed, would improve the law, the remaining amendments proposed […]
title: One Step Forward, Two Steps Back: CA’s AB 1856 Exempts Open Source But Expands Age-Gating

description: The whole conversation around AI is about to get much, much worse.
